entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you with your VeloFit product today?
Finally! I want to return this VeloBand Pulse. This is ridiculous, I've been on hold for ten minutes.
I do apologize for the wait time. I can certainly look into a return for you. To start, could you please provide your order number?
It's VF-8675309. And don't give me a runaround. I want a full refund, now. This entire month has been a nightmare.

I understand your frustration. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. Before we proceed, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the device? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

The issue is I don't want it! Is that a good enough reason? My husband is on military deployment, I'm handling everything, and my son had an emergency. We've been in and out of the hospital for the last three weeks after he needed surgery. The last thing on my mind was your return window.
I'm very sorry to hear about your son's emergency and the stress you've been under. Please don't worry about the return window. Let me just check the policy for you. One moment.
You'd better. I'm a VIP member, and if you deny this, I'm taking it to social media and my credit card company. I don't have time for this.

No need for that, I can resolve this for you. Okay, I've checked our knowledge base. It looks like you received the item 28 days ago, on December 15th. Our standard return policy is 10 days, so you are unfortunately outside the timeframe for a full refund.
Oh. Well... good. So you can process it then?

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return. You'll receive a pre-paid shipping label in your email within the next 15 minutes. Once we receive the item, we'll process a full refund back to your original payment method.
Okay. Thank you. I appreciate that.

Of course. And as you mentioned you're a VIP member, and given the difficult circumstances with your son's surgery and your husband's deployment, I'd also like to add a $50 store credit to your VeloFit account for the trouble. No expiration date. We value your business.
Wow, I... I wasn't expecting that. That's very kind. Thank you, David.
You're most welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been very helpful.
Great. I hope your son has a speedy recovery. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a better day.
